meta.title: AI Video Cataloger
meta.description: A Node.js/TypeScript CLI tool that analyzes videos in a folder, transcribes them, generates summaries, and renames them based on content.

epics.title: Project Setup
epics.description: Initialize the project structure, configuration files, and basic CLI skeleton

stories.title: Initialize TypeScript Project
stories.description: As a developer, I want a properly configured TypeScript project so that I can write type-safe code.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with name 'ai-video-cataloger' and proper scripts (build, start, dev)
tsconfig.json configured for Node.js 18+ with strict mode enabled
src/ directory structure created as per architecture
All dependencies from techStack are listed in package.json
.gitignore includes node_modules, dist, .env
npm install runs without errors
npm run build compiles TypeScript to dist/ folder

stories.title: Create TypeScript Types
stories.description: As a developer, I want shared TypeScript interfaces so that types are consistent across the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: src/types/index.ts exports all shared interfaces
VideoFile interface with path, name, extension, size, modifiedDate
Settings interface with whisperMode, whisperModel, frameCount, renameVideos
VideoStatus enum with all processing states
ProcessingResult interface for pipeline results
PrerequisiteCheck interface for dependency validation

epics.title: Prerequisites System
epics.description: Implement dependency checking to validate required tools are installed

stories.title: Implement Prerequisites Checker
stories.description: As a user, I want the CLI to check for required dependencies on startup so that I know what's missing before processing fails.
acceptanceCriteria: checkPrerequisites() function checks for: Node.js 18+, ffmpeg, claude CLI
Whisper check is conditional based on whisperMode setting
Each check runs the command with version flag and parses output
Missing dependencies show install hints with platform-specific instructions
Outdated dependencies show warning with current vs required version
Function exits with code 1 if required dependencies are missing
Successful check displays green checkmarks with versions
Check is skipped for --help and --version flags

codeSnippets.interface: interface PrerequisiteCheck { name: string; command: string; versionFlag: string; minVersion?: string; required: boolean; installHint: string; }

epics.title: Database Layer
epics.description: Implement SQLite database for progress tracking and resumable processing

stories.title: Initialize SQLite Database
stories.description: As a user, I want the tool to track processing progress so that interrupted jobs can be resumed.
acceptanceCriteria: Database file created at .ai-video-cataloger/catalog.db in working directory
videos table created with schema: id, original_path, original_name, new_name, file_hash, status, timestamps, error_message
config table created for key-value storage
models table created for tracking downloaded Whisper models
initDatabase() creates tables if they don't exist
getDatabase() returns singleton connection

codeSnippets.schema: CREATE TABLE videos (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, original_path TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, original_name TEXT NOT NULL, new_name TEXT, file_hash TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', frames_extracted_at DATETIME, transcribed_at DATETIME, analyzed_at DATETIME, renamed_at DATETIME, completed_at DATETIME, error_message TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

stories.title: Implement Progress Tracking Functions
stories.description: As a developer, I want database helper functions so that I can easily query and update video processing status.
acceptanceCriteria: addVideo(path) inserts new video record or returns existing
updateStatus(id, status) updates video status and corresponding timestamp
getVideoByPath(path) returns video record or null
getPendingVideos() returns all non-completed videos ordered by created_at
getVideosByStatus(status) returns filtered list
setError(id, message) sets error status and message
resetVideo(id) resets video to pending status
resetAll() clears all video records

epics.title: Video Discovery
epics.description: Implement video file scanning in the target directory

stories.title: Implement Video Scanner
stories.description: As a user, I want the tool to find all video files in a directory so that they can be processed.
acceptanceCriteria: scanForVideos(directory) returns array of VideoFile objects
Supported extensions: .mp4, .mov, .avi, .mkv, .webm, .m4v
Only scans current directory (not recursive)
Returns file metadata: path, name, extension, size, modifiedDate
Filters out hidden files (starting with .)
Sorted by filename alphabetically
Returns empty array if no videos found

epics.title: Frame Extraction
epics.description: Extract frames from videos using ffmpeg

stories.title: Implement FFmpeg Utilities
stories.description: As a developer, I want ffmpeg wrapper functions so that video processing is abstracted.
acceptanceCriteria: getVideoDuration(path) returns duration in seconds
getVideoMetadata(path) returns resolution, codec, fps
ffmpeg commands use fluent-ffmpeg library
Errors are caught and wrapped with meaningful messages

stories.title: Implement Frame Extractor
stories.description: As a user, I want frames extracted from videos so that they can be analyzed by AI.
acceptanceCriteria: extractFrames(videoPath, outputDir, frameCount) extracts N frames
Frames extracted at evenly distributed timestamps (not start/end)
For 3 frames in 60s video: timestamps at 15s, 30s, 45s
Output format: frame-001.jpg, frame-002.jpg, etc.
Frames saved to frames/{video-name}/ subdirectory
Returns array of frame file paths
Creates output directory if it doesn't exist
Uses high-quality JPEG output (quality 2)

codeSnippets.timestamps: function getTimestamps(duration: number, frameCount: number): number[] { const step = duration / (frameCount + 1); return Array.from({ length: frameCount }, (_, i) => step * (i + 1)); }

epics.title: Audio Extraction & Transcription
epics.description: Extract audio and transcribe using Whisper

stories.title: Implement Audio Extractor
stories.description: As a developer, I want to extract audio from videos so that it can be transcribed.
acceptanceCriteria: extractAudio(videoPath, outputPath) extracts audio track
Output format: WAV 16kHz mono (optimal for Whisper)
Handles videos without audio track gracefully
Returns output path on success, null if no audio

stories.title: Implement Transcriber Service
stories.description: As a user, I want videos transcribed so that I can search and understand their content.
acceptanceCriteria: transcribe(audioPath, options) transcribes audio to text
Supports 'local' mode using whisper CLI
Supports 'api' mode using OpenAI Whisper API
Local mode uses configurable model (tiny/base/small/medium/large-v3)
API mode requires OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable
Returns transcript text string
Saves transcript to transcripts/{video-name}.txt
Handles empty/silent audio gracefully

epics.title: Vision Analysis
epics.description: Analyze video frames using Claude Code CLI

stories.title: Implement Vision Analyzer
stories.description: As a user, I want video frames analyzed by AI so that I get accurate content descriptions.
acceptanceCriteria: analyzeFrames(framePaths, transcript) calls Claude Code CLI
Passes frame images using --files flag
Includes transcript in the prompt
Prompt asks for: 2-3 sentence description, suggested filename (3-5 words, kebab-case)
Parses Claude's response to extract description and filename suggestion
Returns { description: string, suggestedName: string }
Handles Claude CLI errors gracefully with retry logic

codeSnippets.prompt: Analyze these ${frameCount} video frames and the transcription below. Describe the video content in 2-3 sentences. Then suggest a short descriptive filename (3-5 words, kebab-case, no date). Transcription: ${transcriptContent}

epics.title: Summarization & File Output
epics.description: Generate summaries and manage output files

stories.title: Implement Summarizer Service
stories.description: As a user, I want summary files created for each video so that I can quickly understand their content.
acceptanceCriteria: generateSummary(videoPath, analysis, transcript) creates summary object
Summary includes: original filename, AI description, suggested name, transcript excerpt
saveSummary(summary, outputPath) writes formatted text file
Summary saved to summaries/{video-name}.txt
Format is human-readable with clear sections

stories.title: Implement File Utilities
stories.description: As a developer, I want file helper functions for common operations.
acceptanceCriteria: ensureDirectory(path) creates directory if it doesn't exist
calculateFileHash(path) returns MD5 hash of file
getFileModifiedDate(path) returns Date object
safeRename(oldPath, newPath) renames with conflict handling
cleanupTempFiles(paths) deletes temporary files

stories.title: Implement Slug Generator
stories.description: As a developer, I want to generate URL-safe slugs from text.
acceptanceCriteria: generateSlug(text) returns kebab-case string
Removes special characters and accents
Limits length to reasonable size (50 chars max)
Handles empty/null input gracefully

epics.title: File Renaming
epics.description: Rename videos and associated files based on AI analysis

stories.title: Implement Renamer Service
stories.description: As a user, I want videos renamed based on their content so that my library is organized.
acceptanceCriteria: generateNewName(videoFile, suggestedName) creates new filename
Format: YYYY-MM-DD_suggested-name.ext
Date comes from file modification time
renameVideo(oldPath, newPath) renames video file
Conflict resolution: appends -2, -3, etc. if name exists
renameAssociatedFiles(oldBaseName, newBaseName) renames transcript, summary, frames folder
Returns new path after rename

epics.title: Model Management
epics.description: Download and manage local Whisper models

stories.title: Implement Model Manager
stories.description: As a user, I want to download and select Whisper models so that I can balance speed vs accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: listAvailableModels() returns array of model info (name, size, description)
listDownloadedModels() returns models in local storage
downloadModel(modelName) downloads model with progress indicator
setActiveModel(modelName) sets model as default in config
getActiveModel() returns current active model or default
getModelPath(modelName) returns local path to model file
Models stored in .ai-video-cataloger/models/ directory
Supports: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3

stories.title: Implement Interactive Menu
stories.description: As a user, I want an interactive menu so that I can configure settings without remembering CLI flags.
acceptanceCriteria: showMainMenu(videoCount, directory) displays main menu
Options: Start with defaults, Configure settings, View current settings, Exit
configureSettings() shows settings prompts
Settings: transcription mode, Whisper model, frame count, rename toggle
viewSettings(settings) displays current configuration
Returns Settings object or null if user exits
Uses inquirer for interactive prompts
Displays video count and directory path

epics.title: CLI Interface
epics.description: Implement command-line interface with all commands and flags

stories.title: Implement CLI Parser
stories.description: As a user, I want a well-structured CLI so that I can use the tool efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses Commander.js for argument parsing
Default command processes videos in directory
Accepts directory path as positional argument
Flags: --frames, --whisper, --skip-rename, --skip-transcribe, --verbose
Flags: --yes/-y (skip menu), --non-interactive
Subcommand: models (list, download, use, status)
Subcommand: status (show processing progress)
Subcommand: reset [filename] (reset progress)
--help and --version work without prerequisite checks

stories.title: Implement CLI Entry Point
stories.description: As a user, I want to run the tool from command line.
acceptanceCriteria: src/index.ts is the entry point with shebang
Imports and runs CLI parser
Handles uncaught errors gracefully
Exits with appropriate codes (0 success, 1 error)

epics.title: Main Processing Pipeline
epics.description: Integrate all services into the main processing flow

stories.title: Implement Main Processing Pipeline
stories.description: As a user, I want videos processed end-to-end so that they are transcribed, summarized, and renamed.
acceptanceCriteria: processVideo(video, settings) processes single video through all steps
Pipeline: scan -> hash -> extract frames -> extract audio -> transcribe -> analyze -> summarize -> rename
Updates database status after each step
Handles errors at any step, marks video as error status
processVideos(videos, settings) processes array with progress display
Resumes from last successful step for interrupted videos
Skips already completed videos
Shows spinner/progress with ora
Cleanup temp files after processing

stories.title: Integrate All Components in CLI
stories.description: As a user, I want the complete flow to work when I run the CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: Running 'ai-video-cataloger' with no args shows interactive menu
Running with --yes skips menu and uses defaults
Prerequisites checked before any processing
Videos scanned and count displayed
Processing runs with progress indicators
Output directories created: transcripts/, summaries/, frames/
Database tracks all progress in .ai-video-cataloger/catalog.db
Ctrl+C gracefully stops processing
Re-running resumes from where it left off

workingDirectory.frames/: Subdirectories per video containing extracted frames

testingStrategy.unit: Each service should have corresponding test file in __tests__/
testingStrategy.integration: Test full pipeline with sample video files
manual: Run tool on directory with videos
Interrupt with Ctrl+C and verify resume works
